title: #74 slice 3: @swarm review command and cross-family routing
body:
Implements [§7 and §8 of the design](docs/design/74-external-review.md). Part of #74; depends on slice 2.

- Add `@swarm review #<pr> [at <sha>]` with optional `authored-by:` and `paths:`, following the same draft → `@swarm confirm` flow as tasks. The draft shows the PR's head, its title, and the verifier routing would pick.
- Author families come from `Co-Authored-By` trailers, agent footers and author emails, unioned with the operator's `authored-by:`. Never replaced.
- Progression issues the review only to a verifier of a different family. If none is eligible, the task is a persistent decline `no_eligible_verifier`, announced once through #77. It is never self-reviewed.
- Re-review of the same PR at a new head is a **new task** (§11.1).
